notes.title: Patch #9.1
notes.content: Add option to change text brightness

notes.title: Patch #9
notes.content:
Big editorial update

Bug fixes:

 Maximilian is less chatty in the forest (he doesn't repeat one dialogue twice in certain circumstances)
 Dora doesn't skip the morning animation after Iris' nightmare on the bus
 Roy's music theme is a bit louder
 Apricot always properly hides behind the log

notes.title: Patch 8.3
notes.content: Fixed issues on older embedded AMD GPUs

notes.title: Patch 8.1
notes.content: Performance tweaks and minor bug fixes

notes.title: Patch #8: Performance and Steam Deck compatibility
notes.content:
Startup performance increace
 Increased performance in low-memory situations
 Now, if using controller in big picture and on Steam Deck on-screen keyboard will appear when editing save names
 Menu UI has been changed for better readability on small screens

notes.title: Patch 7.1
notes.content:
Pulled Iris from behind the bed
 Small performance improvements
 Spanish localization updates


We are working on Spanish localization and big performance improvements

notes.title: Patch #7: Auto-Read
notes.content: By popular request, we added the Auto-Read (a.k.a. Auto-Scroll ) option to the game. It can be activated using the "A" key on the keyboard, and speed can be adjusted in settings.

notes.title: Hotfix 6.5.1: Updates to savegame interface
notes.content: In save game interface now there is an option to confirm save name with mouse click

notes.title: Patch 6.5
notes.content:
Fix issues on intel UHD <3000
 Fix issues with 4k resolution on systems with <2Gb of memory
 Fix typos

notes.title: Big Sound Overhaul
notes.content:
The sound overhaul is here!

We’ve added individual music themes for the following…

Characters

 Takeo
 Tien
 Maximilian
 Roy
 The main antagonist

Locations

 Farm
 Police station (including the downstairs)
 Bus stopovers

Situations
The fun, the eerie, the conflicted, the sad, and the mysterious =)

And much more!

And we’re now working on an autoscroll to introduce in the next patch.

notes.title: Patch #5
notes.content:
You can now press Shift+H to hide the entire interface mid-game—and snap those beautiful screenshots!
To bring the interface and text back, simply press Shift+H again.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43032158/e601a0f11c65d48f381a1e18c4485e6ee587d569.png

Minor fixes:

 Tony’s cracks no longer multiply at their own discretion
 In the old town library, points of interest do not overlap with the diary icon anymore
 Candy has gotten a grip and now brings over cookies less often
 From now on, unstabilised areas will look less stabilised at the police station when Iris is downstairs alone

We’re elbows deep in that sound overhaul, and it’s shaping up great! =)

notes.title: Patch #4
notes.content:
We’ve added an “Extra QTE time” option to the settings: it gives you x300 more time to complete each QTE.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43032158/d6a2e058b445facb74518e291d51c44045a74f5a.png

After some thorough consideration, we decided against introducing an auto-skip for QTEs: there are situations in the game when you need to make a choice under a time constraint, and we wouldn’t want to make that choice for you. =)) But the time extension should do!

Minor fixes:

 Iris now handles her glass of whisky more carefully
 Iris and Johnny now enjoy a few snacks as they drink the whisky
 Dora no longer tries to teleport the player to previously visited bus stops

We continue working on the sound overhaul, gradually adding new musical themes for the characters, and we’re considering introducing a photo mode, too.

notes.title: Patch #3
notes.content:
We’ve added the option to skip read text, as well as the rewind button.
This is how it looks:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43032158/d9ae678440b79a971e9f8d5e01fddbf34963458d.png

You can also find it with the rest of the controls for your convenience =)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43032158/715a7fbc3114f39287e2920ce57c3b677ed6688a.png
Minor fixes:

 Iris no longer wears jewellery that she has never been gifted
 The ragman’s shop is now a bit less dusty
 Dora now shuts the door to the accessories shop
 The coffee froth isn’t trying to escape Suz’s glass anymore


We’re working on a major audio update, which is taking up most of our time. 
That doesn’t mean we forgot about the QTEs: making them easier to complete is in progress, too ))

notes.title: Patch 2.5
notes.content:
Audio:

  spoiler, spoiler, spoiler  and spoiler now come with sound
  We’ve added a musical theme to various investigation stages

Minor visual fixes:

  Roy’s handwriting is now somewhat less sweeping
  If Johnny isn’t friends with Iris, he will no longer read the letters she and Roy exchange with each other
  All the non-secret letters are now less secretive overall
 Tien’s boat has mastered sailing away rather gracefully

Text:

 More proofreading!

Plans:

 We’re working on a smoother solution for rewinding the story already covered and on skipping QTEs

notes.title: Patch #2
notes.content:
Save Management Improved!
You can now overwrite existing saves or delete them. If you don’t need this, the game will autosave regularly, including before you exit.

Fixes:

 Notifications for achievements are no longer duplicated
 The cat no longer levitates
 Maximilian has been rescued from behind the textures. To the contrary, we hid Leo somewhat
 Musical themes have been added for Tony and Mr.Hansen
 Johnny has agreed to carry Iris into the void only once per playthrough (took some convincing, though)
 Dora now listens to Iris with greater attention in the forest

notes.title: Enhanced UI, Bug Fixes, and Improved Performance!
notes.content:
Here’s what’s new:

Updated User Interface: We’ve listened to your feedback and implemented accidental skip protections. 

Bug Fixes: Say goodbye to those pesky bugs! We've specifically addressed the issue causing a block when using the rollback feature. 

Performance Upgrades: Players using embedded GPUs will notice a significant boost in performance. We’ve optimized the game to ensure a more fluid experience across various hardware setups.

Your experience matters to us, and we're committed to continuous improvement. As always, we’d love to hear your thoughts and feedback. Feel free to drop a comment, or reach out through our community forums or support.

Thank you for your support and for being part of our community!

notes.title: UI Updates and Spanish localization
notes.content:
Hello! Ahead of Steam Visual Novel Fest, we would like to share some news:

 Demo is now localized into Spanish, if you spot some issues, please let us know
 Updated a game UI to separate thoughts and dialogue better:
